audience: e-commerce teams that track competitor prices with Prisync

useCases.title: Compare your prices with competitors
useCases.text: List the products with their prices and the competitor prices.

useCases.title: Review SmartPrice suggestions
useCases.text: List the SmartPrice suggestions to see where a price change could help.

useCases.title: Check a competitor URL
useCases.text: Open a competitor URL to read the last price and the stock.

useCases.title: Add a product to track
useCases.text: Add a new product, then add the competitor URL to watch.

useCases.title: Correct product details
useCases.text: Edit the name, the brand or the category of a product.
